reference_description: Mars 2015 sphere; east-positive longitude, source planetocentric latitude, native equirectangular meters; east-west distortion about 0.35 percent.

preparation.slope_policy: Central differences at native resolution; maximum over every search block; all 3x3 native stencil pixels must be valid.
preparation.elevation_policy: Mean of unchanged native block values; no display shifts. Native values with halo retained verbatim.
preparation.coverage_policy: All source samples and derivative stencils in a whole block valid; otherwise untraversable. No filling or neighbor snapping.
preparation.exclusion_policy: No supplied scientific exclusion layer; explicit all-false mask. Team slope/edge limits still apply. Small rocks and material hazards are unevaluated.

location_selection: Base at the closest valid cell to the Nevado Sajama panorama (Mastcam, sol 4714-4741) that joins the connected terrain for 15-degree teams (46.2 m). Destinations at Navcam 360 stops: sample = sol 4818 (0.8 m, short), control = sol 4844 (3.0 m, medium), lookout = sol 4571 (0.8 m, long). Selected with the default team (Morgan Vale + Transport Rover, 15 degrees); teams limited below 15 degrees cannot connect here (8-degree rover: no route). Scene registration inverted once (+25 m east, -35 m north); photo coordinates unchanged.

geographic_adapter.evidence: scripts/build_hirise_tiles.py and CLAUDE.md: 144 points, reported height residual spread 0.9 m, 2026-11-14. Raw control samples were not delivered; fresh visual review required. Panorama +71.2 m is unrelated.
